title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
In the first part, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first face using two loops. In the first loop, draw a rectangle with vertices at (0.0, 0.0), (0.0625, 0.0), (0.0625, 0.0417), and (0.0, 0.0417). In the second loop, draw a smaller inner rectangle with vertices at (0.0033, 0.0033), (0.0592, 0.0033), (0.0592, 0.0383), and (0.0033, 0.0383). Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0625. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero, no further transformation is needed. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a rectangular section with a smaller inner rectangle. The dimensions of this part are: length of 0.0625, width of 0.041666666666666664, and height of 0.75. This operation will create a new solid body.

For the second part, begin by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to 0.0, 0.0, and -90.0, and a translation vector of 0.0267, 0.0, and 0.2871. Draw the first face with a single loop, creating a circle centered at (0.0046, 0.0046) with a radius of 0.0046. Draw the second face with another single loop, creating a circle centered at (0.0046, 0.2546) with the same radius. Scale the 2D sketch by a factor of 0.2592. Rotate the sketch by -90 degrees around the Z-axis and translate it by 0.0267 units along the X-axis and 0.2871 units along the Z-axis. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.0417 units in the opposite direction of the normal to form a cylindrical section with two circular holes. The dimensions of this part are: length of 0.009166666666666667, width of 0.2591666666666667, and height of 0.041666666666666664. This operation will remove material from the existing body.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0625, 0).lineTo(0.0625, 0.0417).lineTo(0, 0.0417).close() \
    .moveTo(0.0033, 0.0033).lineTo(0.0592, 0.0033).lineTo(0.0592, 0.0383).lineTo(0.0033, 0.0383).close() \
    .extrude(0.75)

# Part 2
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0046, 0.0046).circle(0.0046) \
    .moveTo(0.0046, 0.2546).circle(0.0046) \
    .extrude(-0.0417, combine=False)

# Translate and rotate part_2
part_2 = part_2.translate((0.0267, 0, 0.2871)).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.cut(part_2)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
outer_x = 0.0625
outer_y = 0.0417
height = 0.7500

# Wall thickness
wall = 0.0083

# Create the outer box
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(outer_x, outer_y, height, centered=(False, False, False))
)

# Create the inner cutout (hollow tube)
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0)
    .center(wall, wall)
    .box(outer_x - 2 * wall, outer_y - 2 * wall, height, centered=(False, False, False))
)

# Cut the inner box from the outer box
r = r.cut(inner)

# Translate to positive octant
r = r.translate((0, 0, 0))
